original.required_interface: A verified unitary braided Fibonacci category realizing the stated fusion rules, unitary F-symbols, and fixed-chirality R-symbols; in particular, a correct verification of the total-τ hexagon entry.
original.actual_evidence: The supplier body is present. In items/ex-qc-tqc-fibonacci-data.md, Verification step 3.2 prints the fourth entry condition as uy(ux+u²y)=-uy. From x=y² and y²+uy+1=0, its next displayed identity gives ux+u²y=-u, so the matrix entry condition required by B₂D=EF is y(ux+u²y)=-uy. The printed condition has an extra factor u and is not established by the subsequent identity. The numerical sector data remain available as explicit hypotheses; no category-coherence acceptance is claimed.
affected_claims: unitary associator transport between grouped and left-associated six-anyon trees
spectator-safe physical braid realization on the actual Fibonacci fusion space
pair-charge/triple-code comparison inside one coherent category
